causes: R1: plan step 496250 is not after the a2 launch's first model step 496250 (a start there is the companion itself, no a2 world record precedes it to screen a rebuilt start against, and the a2 completion reading counts only plan captures after 496250)
R7: the a2 recording holds no world record 496249 of body 7 (the start record)

launch_step.meaning: model step 496,250's start record 496,249 is not in the a2 recording (R7) but in the preserved S4R_measure_496000 recording; continuous with a2 when a2's record 496,250 is 5 physics steps and 0.05 s after it

p_command.meaning: P's strength column (8) per row, 0 = no push and 1 = full, and its handle mask; D keeps both, so D pushes each row at P's strength

root_between_target_and_start.meaning: how far the infant's root (free joint, qpos 0 to 6) moved (cm; horizontally: x and y) and turned (degrees) between the target's world record and the start record. D's rows are the target's world positions and turns, recorded with the root there: from the start, the limbs must make up this shift and turn, or the root must move back

stored_convention_start_vs_capture_start.meaning: the rebuilt start's data.xpos / xquat against the pose the learner read at the plan step (the capture's start_pose, float32 positions / 200); 0 = the same pose

reported_only.ctrl_note: data.ctrl after the replayed model step's last physics step against the record's float16 ctrl (float16 keeps 11 significant bits: 0.00049 near 1); never decoded or replayed

7.start_label: start accepted by the fidelity screens

P.mask_note: masked_rows None: the record holds no mask; [] = every row on

D.rule: P's rows with every row but the eyes' position = target x 200 and orientation = the target's quaternion; P's radius, strength, eyes' row, mask and hand joint goal: D pushes at P's strengths (P.strength_by_row)

commands.hand_goal_rule: both arms send P's recorded hand joint goal (THE FINGER TREATMENT)
commands.gaze_rule: records 496260 to 496264's eye commands, then record 496264's held

counting_start.meaning: the same rules with model step 0 allowed as an arrival step

E.meaning: over the 25 handles but the eyes: the 15 scored parts and the 10 fingertips, which follow P's recorded hand joint goal in every arm

E_15.meaning: over the 15 scored parts only: no fingertip, no eyes

contacts.note: a contact with anything but the floor is reported, never counted as a failure

forecast.note: the recorded forecast covers the command's own 5 model steps; it is compared with no later step

paired.meaning: D minus P; below 0 = the direct command nearer the target; outcomes from these reconstructed starts, no winner and no transfer claim

repeat.meaning: equal digests over every model step show that this process repeats the arms' physics; they say nothing about the start's match to the record
